dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge with a deep concave spline curvature from the posterior insertion point to the sub-apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Bluntly rounded morphological peak with a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Moderately low-slope convex margin, approximately 35 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width is approximately 1.5 times the vertical height from the dorsal midline.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Shallow, low-profile convexity with a large radius of curvature across the dorsal cranial surface.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum extending from the melon with a high thickness-to-length ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle visible at the transition point between the melon slope and the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small circular white mark or lesion located at the extreme distal tip of the dorsal fin apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniform luminescent cyan-green surface texture across the entire dermal silhouette, likely an artifact of rendering or monochromatic lighting.
